supersedes_for_single_source_path: V63_E2_DESIGN_CONTRACT_V1 C1/C4/C6/C12 where those clauses are incompatible with the explicitly authorised Nott-centered fallback

trigger.condition: Exactly one admissible open primary-microglia contact source is available.
trigger.current_state: TRIGGERED: Nott Table S5 is authenticated and in hand; DS010 is embargoed until 2027-02-01; Yang pcHi-C artifact remains unlocated; Kosoy Hi-C is access-required/supporting-only.

core_ruling.reason: Cross-source concordance cannot be measured with one admissible contact source. Same-study neuron/oligodendrocyte concordance is not independent source replication and must not be relabelled as P1.

object_names_and_claim_scope.definition: Nott-defined primary-microglia promoter-distal contact pairs, source-thresholded by the depositors, hg19->hg38 harmonized under the frozen liftover rule, and qualified for microglial substrate fit under same-study cell-type controls.
object_names_and_claim_scope.promotion_rule: Only after independent validation-cohort correspondence passes may the object be promoted to the project's validated E2 authority class.

P1S_SINGLE_SOURCE_SUBSTRATE_QUALIFICATIO.purpose: Establish that the Nott contact substrate is nontrivially compatible with microglial regulatory substrate before it becomes load-bearing, without pretending this is independent contact replication.
required_components: mechanical authentication of Table S5 and microglia interactome sheet
same-study microglia-vs-neuron-vs-oligodendrocyte substrate-fit test under the separately frozen V64 Nott same-study contract
promoter-fixed distal shuffle showing observed microglial accessibility support exceeds geometry-preserving chance
P1S_SINGLE_SOURCE_SUBSTRATE_QUALIFICATIO.interpretation: A pass supports MICROGLIA_SUBSTRATE_FIT of the Nott-centered contact object. It does not establish cross-source replication.

C2_source_thresholds_instantiated_from_a.significance: FDR < 0.01, inherited from the deposited pre-thresholded interactome; all 104802 microglia rows satisfy it
C2_source_thresholds_instantiated_from_a.cis_span: 10 kb to 1 Mb observed support window, not analyst-selected
C2_source_thresholds_instantiated_from_a.anchor_width: 5 kb uniformly in the deposited interactome
C2_source_thresholds_instantiated_from_a.forbidden: No rethresholding or contact filtering based on downstream overlap.

C3_build.source_build: hg19, independently confirmed by coordinates exceeding hg38 chr1 length
C3_build.rule: single named chain, both anchors must map to same chromosome, attrition counted, round-trip reported

C6_successor_adjustment.reason: The frozen granularity frontier showed NO_FEASIBLE_REGION_ON_THIS_FRONTIER: TECH cleared only after severe support collapse; the continuous-adjustment successor cleared represented nuisance families with 960/960 linked pairs and broad ESS.
C6_successor_adjustment.primary: Use the frozen continuous-adjustment estimator lineage, subject to its V64 leakage and out-of-span stress qualifications.
C6_successor_adjustment.matching_role: coarsened matching may remain a sensitivity analysis only; it must not define the primary estimand or silently trim the population.

C12_SINGLE_SOURCE_PRECONDITIONS_BEFORE_E: authenticate Table S5 exact bytes and record digests
execute hg19->hg38 liftover and round-trip qualification
execute P1S same-study substrate-fit and promoter-fixed distal shuffle
verify the chosen accessibility source bytes and terms
execute cell-type negative eligibility filtering and report trivial-negative attrition
verify the continuous-adjustment estimator's V64 leakage/out-of-span qualifications before using it for validation-cohort correspondence

future_second_source_rule.when_Ds010_or_other_source_becomes_admis: Reactivate original P1 cross-source concordance prospectively as an upgrade test.
future_second_source_rule.upgrade: A successful independent-source concordance result can promote the contact-construction claim from Nott-centered to multi-source supported; failure does not retroactively falsify the Nott object but limits claim scope.
